Name: Sycamore Farm
Author: starmops
Description:
What this mod does

This mod will replace the Forest Farm Map with a new Secret Woods-style forest that's much more overgrown. This map was made for players  who like to create a lot of different "zones" while keeping a natural feel to the farm. There are seven interconnected clearings, three with ponds, and some new overhead tree and woodland flower tiles to give the woods some biodiversity!

This mod also replaces the Farm Cave map to add... a secret cave! The cave is located under the large cherry tree in the leftmost clearing. It provides a bit of extra storage for secret treasure (or your extensive collection of scarecrows).

Features

- All grass tiles are diggable/farmable
- Access the secret tunnel by walking over the trapdoor at the bottom of the cherry tree (in the vanilla version, the trapdoor is replaced with a suspicious-looking rock instead)
- All other aspects of the forest farm are preserved so the same forageable items will appear

Recolor Notes

I've made separate versions of this map which are compatible with the Vibrant Pastoral Recolor and DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour mods, along with a vanilla version. Download the one that you like best! If you want to use any other recolors, download the vanilla version which should be compatible.

Compatibility

This mod won't be compatible with any other mod that replaces the Forest Farm map OR the Farm Cave map

**This mod has been updated to accommodate the new greenhouse mechanics in 1.5, but hasn't been extensively tested yet!**
